7.description: [Area-52] [Arcane Thunder Seer] - Reduced the base damage and scaling of Spellstorm Missiles by 15%.
[Area-52] [Paratrooper] - Target Spotted now increases damage taken from the caster by 6%, down from 8%.
[Area-52] [Locust Ranger] - Fixed a bug causing Wild Locust Swarm to deal higher then intended damage to targets affected by the casters Serpent Sting.
[Area-52] [Locust Ranger] - Locust Shot no longer guarantees a Wild Quiver Shot against targets affected by your Serpent Sting.
[Area-52] [Locust Ranger] - Toxic Surge in addition to Locust Shot hits against targets affected by your Serpent Sting reduce the cooldown of Chimera Shot by 2 seconds.
[Area-52] [Locust Ranger] - Chimera Shot and Toxic Surge can now trigger Wild Quiver Shot.

[Area-52] [Flashpoint Operative] Engine of Destruction now increases the damage of ranged hunter abilities, Living Bomb and Fire Blast by 8%, down from 12%. The critical strike chance increase remains at 12%.
[Area-52] [Compound Power] - Compound Flurry now also increases the critical strike chance of Steady Shot by 15%.
[Area-52] [Compound Power] - Increased the ranged weapon damage of Combo Shot from 150% to 175%.
[Area-52] [Compound Power] - The global cooldown of the Combo Shot is now 0.5 seconds, down from 1 second.
[Area-52] [Arcane Gunslinger] - Arcane Bullets weapon damage has been reduced by 10% on each rank.
[Area-52] [Elune] [Focused Burst] - Fixed a bug causing Focused Burst to be able to trigger Thrill of the Hunt twice per channel.

[Area-52] [Warden of Demonreach] - Fixed an issue causing the proc chance of Duality of Winter and Summer was higher then intended, the proc chance is now properly 20% and is now listed in the tooltip.
[Area-52] [Warden of Demonreach] - Reduced the base damage and scaling of Fuego, Unleashed Fuego, Arctis and Unleashed Arctis by 10%.
[Area-52] [Pure Shadow] - Now has a new mechanic: Dealing direct damage with Shadowburn against monsters now reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 1 second.
[Area-52] [Midnight Flames] - Midnight Flames now increases the damage of Shadowflame and Immolate by 17%. Up from 16%.
[Area-52] [Midnight Flames] - Shadow Kindling now increases the critical strike chance of Fireball, Fire Blast and Pyroblast by 3%.
[Area-52] [Verdant Convergence] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Earthpulse Agony by 10%.
[Area-52] [Verdant Convergence] - Nature's Grace now increases the damage of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 18%. Up from 15%.
[Area-52] [Booming Thunder] - Booming Thunder buff now stacks up to 26 times. Up from 22.
[Arae-52] [Knight of the Eclipse] - Lunar and Solar Knight now increase the damage of Wrath,Starfire and Starsurge by 70%. Up from 60%.
[Area-52] [Harbinger of Pestilence] - The Harbinger of Pestilence buff now increases the damage of your diseases by 22%. Up from 20%.
[Area-52] [Burning Darkness] - Flame Born now increases the damage of your Shadowflame by 18%.
[Area-52] [Elune] - Decreased the base damage and scaling of Soul Fire by 6%.
[Area-52] [Elune] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Chaos Bolt by 10%.
[Area-52] [Master of Shadows] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Dark Intent by 15%.
[Area-52] [Darkmaster] - Necromancer's Touch now increases the damage of your Drain Life by 22%. Up from 20%.
[Area-52] [Prophet of Wrath] - Divine Wrath now increases the damage of your next Smite or Holy Fire by 25%. Up from 15%.
[Area-52] [Evoker] - The Evoker buff now increases the damage of your Fireball by 10% and Arcane Missiles by 4%. Changed from 8% to both.
[Area-52] [Hot Hands] - Superheated now increases Fire damage and spell haste by 3%. Down from 4%.

[Area-52] [Hot Hands] - Fixed a tooltip where the Mystic Enchant would mention that the damage over time of your Pyroblast was doubled and it scaled of haste. This was never live and is removed from the description.
[Area-52] [Flamekeeper] - Flamekeeper no longer increases the stack amount of your Pyroblast periodic effect.
[Area-52] [Fingers of Death] - Potency of Vampiric Embrace is reduced by 50% when attacking monsters.
[Area-52] [Fel Shock] - Fel Burst now increases the damage of your next Lava Burst by 40%. Down from 50%.
[Area-52] [Fel Shock] - Fel Core now increases the critical strike chance of your next Soul Fire by 8%. Down from 15%.
[Area-52] [Total Eclipse] - Lunar Eclipse now increases the Arcane damage dealt by 20%. Down from 30%.
[Area-52] [Righteous Flames] - Righteous Flames now increases the damage of your Holy Fire (Righteous Flames) by 40% per stack. Up from 20%.

[TBC] [Tailoring] - Deprecated the current Tailoring High Risk Cloak enchants, these were underused and had better or comparable counterparts already existing in the regular (Non-High Risk) profesion crafting.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Dread Assault and Overpowering Dread Assault now have a 20 second internal cooldown.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Overpowering Void Assault now grants 85 Spell Power and 120 Attack power. Changed from 70/140 respectivelly.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Void Assault now grants 75 Spell Power and 110 Attack power. Changed from 60/125 respectivelly.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Void Assault and Overpowering Void Assault now have a 22.5 second internal cooldown.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Overpowering Twisted Evoker now grants 165 Intellect. Up from 120.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Evoker now grants 140 Intellect. Up from 100.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Evoker and Overpowering Twisted Evoker now lasts 15 seconds. Up from 10 seconds.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Evoker and Overpowering Twisted Evoker now have a 22.5 second internal cooldown. Down from 25 sec.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Overpowering Twisted Onslaught now grants 115 Agility. Down from 144.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Onslaught now grants 100 Agility. Down from 132.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Overpowering Twisted Channeler now grants 190 Spirit. Up from 120.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Channeler now grants 165 Spirit. Up from 110.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Channeler and Overpowering Twisted Channeler now have a 15 second duration. Up from 10 sec.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Twisted Channeler and Overpowering Twisted Channeler now have a 25 second internal cooldown. Up from 18 sec.
[TBC] [Enchanting] - Sunfire, Soulfrost, Faith Weapon enchants now grant 60 of the specific schools of Spell Power. Up from 50.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] Finkle Einhorn, the greatest adventurer to ever live, successfully got lost inside the Sunwell Plateau and awaits his rescue. Again.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [The Eredar Twins] Corrected an issue where the Eredar Twins could both die without transforming if killed at the same time.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kalecgos] Corrected an issue where Kalecgos could eventually reenter combat after being defeated.
[Already Active] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes] Limited the damage to Vengeance conversion while Inpenetrable Bullwark is active to 10% of the absorbed damage.
[Already Active] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes] Corrected an issue where Arynyes would Smite in the wrong direction.

1.description: [Elune] Flesh Hook now applies a debuff to the target, preventing any Flesh Hooks from being used on the target for 30 sec.
[Elune] Flesh Hook now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 15 sec. (Still a 45 second cooldown versus players.)
[Elune] Physics in Practice is now 33% as effective in PvP combat, changed from 50%.
These changes are pending restart, and are now available for Reset at Gabril.
